top_signals.title: Freight broker Fura’s latest deal adds $30M in revenue
top_signals.summary:
Freight broker Fura has acquired Road Dog Logistics, a truckload brokerage, expanding Fura's platform with an estimated $30 million in additional revenue.

The post Freight broker Fura’s latest deal adds $30M in revenue appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
